training_mixture: 50% clean; 25% AWGN; 25% mild/severe multipath. Within the AWGN branch, -5 dB has weight 5 and 0/5/10/15/20 dB each have weight 1, so -5 dB is half of AWGN draws and 12.5% of all draws.
controlled_change: Compared with V3, the only controlled change is the deterministic within-AWGN level weighting: -5 dB increases from 1/6 to 1/2 of AWGN draws. Branch probabilities, data, model, optimizer, seeds, epochs, patience, checkpoint selection, multipath and all evaluation conditions are unchanged.
comparison: Exactly paired against V3 on all 40 frozen known-validation stress conditions, three model seeds and the unchanged probability ensemble.

acceptance.clean_guardrail: candidate three-seed mean clean recording Macro-F1 must be at least V3 minus 0.03
acceptance.minus5_primary_mean: candidate single-model mean across the three -5 dB repeats and three seeds must exceed V3
acceptance.minus5_primary_worst_case: candidate worst seed-repeat -5 dB recording Macro-F1 must strictly exceed the V3 worst seed-repeat
acceptance.zero_to5_guardrail: candidate single-model 0/5 dB mean must be at least V3 minus 0.03
acceptance.multipath_guardrail: candidate single-model multipath mean must be at least V3 minus 0.03
